mechanism: Begin in an identity-close performance frame, keep the performance continuous while one unbroken pullback gradually transfers visual dominance from face to body and then to a responsive environment, and end with the performer still readable inside the now-dominant wide setting.

invariants.rule: Open close enough to establish one stable performer identity.
invariants.purpose: Gives the later scale transfer a human anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening wide makes the performer secondary too early.

invariants.rule: Keep one continuous performance thread through the camera retreat.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the pullback from becoming scenery montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Stopping performance breaks the causal link.

invariants.rule: Reveal the first environmental response before the frame becomes wide.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden final background replacement feels unrelated.

invariants.rule: Transfer visual dominance through camera distance rather than a subject transformation.
invariants.purpose: Makes the scale shift legible and reusable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing the performer instead of the frame changes the mechanism.

invariants.rule: End wide with both performer and responsive environment readable.
invariants.purpose: Completes the relationship without losing identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: A landscape-only ending discards the opening anchor.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source translucent dress and face lighting
